issues.description: Default base image string duplicated across Python constant, RPC, TS constant, and TS fallback literal with no single source of truth.
issues.detail: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE lives in pipeline.py, is re-hardcoded in Commands.ts catch fallback, redeclared as a constant in CellMetadataEditor.tsx, and referenced in the Jinja template. The RPC was added to make this single-sourced but the TS-side literal re-complects it. A future bump to python:3.13 will silently desync. Trust the RPC or drop it.

issues.description: Silent behavior change in _set_base_image: empty fallback now forces python:3.12 instead of deferring to kfp default.
issues.detail: Previously self.base_image = "" signaled 'let kfp choose' when pod introspection failed. Now it pins python:3.12, collapsing 'unspecified' and 'python:3.12' into one value. This is a runtime semantic change affecting every user whose pod-image lookup fails, not the UI cosmetic the PR advertises. Split this from the display change.

issues.description: Effective-image precedence rule is duplicated between Jinja template and InlineMetadata.tsx in two languages.
issues.detail: The template computes `step.config.base_image or base_image or default_base_image`; the TS computes the same fallback chain independently. Two implementations of one rule can drift. Factor into a single named helper (resolveBaseImage) with documented precedence step > pipeline > default, or at minimum comment the canonical invariant.

issues.description: RPC round-trip added to return a compile-time constant string, with hardcoded fallback defeating the purpose.
issues.detail: get_default_base_image is an RPC returning a Python source literal. The labextension calls it on every panel init with try/catch and a hardcoded fallback equal to the same constant. Either inject at build time, bundle into an existing bootstrap RPC alongside kfpUiHost, or drop the indirection. Don't add a network call to read a constant then hardcode it anyway.

issues.description: Replacing inline Input with a 5%-wide IMAGE button plus modal dialog is a UX regression for a single text field.
issues.detail: The old UI let you type the image inline. The new UI hides it behind a button labeled IMAGE (width:'5%', will clip or wrap), opening a modal with one field and Ok/reset. Extra click and more state (baseImageDialogOpen) for the common edit case. Consider keeping the inline input with the default as placeholder/helper text.

issues.description: Local import of DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE inside RPC function body instead of module top.
issues.detail: get_default_base_image does `from kale.pipeline import DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE` inside the function. No circular-import reason is given and nb.py already imports from kale at module scope. Move to the top with other imports to match codebase convention and avoid per-call resolution cost.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The PR was sold as a UI display change but ships a silent runtime behavior change in pipeline.py (empty-string fallback now forces python:3.12 instead of deferring to kfp) and creates four places the default image lives — defeating the RPC's stated purpose as single source of truth. The effective-image precedence rule is also duplicated across Jinja and TSX. UI-wise, replacing an inline Input with a 5%-wide button-plus-modal is a regression. Split the semantic change from the display change, pick one source for the default, and reconsider the dialog.
